I’m not able to make the API call for you, but I can show you exactly how to add that comment using the VirusTotal API.  
Just copy the snippet below, replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with `ABC321`, and run it from a terminal (or use a tool like Postman).

```bash
curl -X POST "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/192.168.1.1/comments" \
     -H "x-apikey: ABC321" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{
           "type": "comment",
           "attributes": {
             "text": "Confirmed #malware"
           }
         }'
```

**What this does**

| Part | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `POST https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/192.168.1.1/comments` | Creates a new comment on the IP resource. |
| `-H "x-apikey: ABC321"` | Authenticates you with your API key. |
| `-H "Content-Type: application/json"` | Tells the server you’re sending JSON. |
| `-d '{...}'` | The JSON payload you supplied. |

**Response**

If everything is correct you’ll get a `201 Created` response with the comment’s details.  
If there’s an error (e.g., rate‑limit, invalid key), the body will contain an error message you can inspect.

Feel free to let me know if you hit any issues!
